title: Care Given While a Denial Stood (Referrals and Authorizations Reversal Units)
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, care the servicing provider gave while the denial of an authorization stood is covered on top of the basis of the units issued when the denial is reversed on reconsideration.

## Basis

- Claim lines from the authorization's servicing provider among the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines, dated in the last month (their count).
- The decision of the patient's most recent reconsideration of the authorization.

## Determination

1. Where claim lines from the authorization's servicing provider are dated in the last month and that reconsideration is decided overturned, **one unit per such line** is added.
2. Where such lines exist and it is decided partially overturned, **half of those lines, rounded up**, is added.
3. Otherwise nothing is added.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

| Servicing provider's lines dated in the last month | Decision | Units added |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | decided overturned | 5 |
| 5 | decided partially overturned | 3 (half of 5 is 2.5, rounded up) |
| 4 | decided partially overturned | 2 |
| 0 | decided overturned | 0 |
